title: 2 Things You Didn't Know About the Aventador SVJ

scenes.text: The Lamborghini Aventador SVJ has a rear wing that is designed to stall on purpose, and a production count that two sources cannot agree on. It also set a Nürburgring record that is quoted three slightly different ways. Two things most people do not know about the Aventador SVJ, with every figure sourced and every disagreement shown.
scenes.caption: 2 THINGS YOU DIDN'T KNOW ABOUT THE LAMBORGHINI AVENTADOR SVJ

scenes.text: Our sources are Wikipedia's Aventador and Huracán pages, an IEEE Spectrum review, an Autocar road test republished by Yahoo, Auto Bild from September twenty eighteen, and the cost pages we flag as weaker. They disagree on weight, price, power and production. We show each version. Our own arithmetic is labelled.
scenes.caption: SOURCES: WIKIPEDIA · IEEE SPECTRUM · AUTOCAR (VIA YAHOO) · AUTO BILD (19 SEP 2018) · AUTOMONITOR (UNSOURCED, FLAGGED) · DISAGREEMENTS SHOWN · OUR ARITHMETIC LABELLED

scenes.text: Thing one. The SVJ's active aerodynamics, which Lamborghini calls ALA. Wikipedia says the SVJ is the first production V12 Lamborghini to have it. It includes a disconnected front splitter, a bonnet air outlet, a large carbon rear wing with a central fin, underbody vortex generators and a big rear diffuser.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: SVJ = FIRST PRODUCTION V12 LAMBORGHINI WITH ALA · DISCONNECTED FRONT SPLITTER · BONNET AIR OUTLET · CARBON REAR WING WITH CENTRAL FIN · UNDERBODY VORTEX GENERATORS · LARGE REAR DIFFUSER
scenes.chapter: Thing one: the wing that stalls on purpose

scenes.text: IEEE Spectrum explains the trick. The wing is made of a polymer stiffened with carbon fibre, which allows hollow internal air channels. When ALA is active, the wing stalls and drag drops, which helps acceleration. That is the sense in which the wing stalls on purpose: it gives up downforce to cut drag when the car does not need grip.
scenes.caption: IEEE SPECTRUM: WING = POLYMER STIFFENED WITH CARBON FIBRE, HOLLOW INTERNAL AIR CHANNELS · WHEN ALA IS ACTIVE THE WING STALLS AND DRAG DROPS, AIDING ACCELERATION · 'GIVES UP DOWNFORCE TO CUT DRAG' = OUR PARAPHRASE

scenes.text: Auto Bild, in September twenty eighteen, describes the same system more simply. Front flaps closed give maximum downforce. Front flaps open give lower drag, for higher top speed and acceleration. The enlarged rear wing is part of the system, and the roadster would later get an update called ALA two point oh.
scenes.caption: AUTO BILD (19 SEP 2018): FRONT FLAPS CLOSED = MAX DOWNFORCE; OPEN = LOWER DRAG · ENLARGED REAR WING PART OF THE SYSTEM · ROADSTER LATER GETS 'ALA 2.0'

scenes.text: Wikipedia says the system works with a second-generation control unit, called LDVA two point oh, that adjusts the car every half a second. IEEE Spectrum adds that above seventy-one kilometres per hour, the rear flaps open and close independently when turning, to adjust downforce on each side and help the car rotate through corners. Adjustments take under half a second.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: LDVA 2.0 ADJUSTS THE CAR EVERY 0.5 S · IEEE SPECTRUM: ABOVE 71 KM/H (44 MPH) REAR FLAPS OPEN/CLOSE INDEPENDENTLY IN TURNS; ADJUSTMENTS < 0.5 S

scenes.text: Both numbers are the same speed, by our arithmetic: seventy-one kilometres per hour is forty-four miles per hour. IEEE gives both. The key idea is that the wing acts on each side of the car separately, a form of torque vectoring through air. Auto Bild notes the car has no conventional torque vectoring, because the engineer cited brake overheating as the reason.
scenes.caption: 71 KM/H = 44.1 MPH (OUR CONVERSION; IEEE GIVES BOTH) · AUTO BILD: NO TORQUE VECTORING — ENGINEER CITED BRAKE OVERHEATING · 'A FORM OF TORQUE VECTORING THROUGH AIR' = OUR ANALOGY, NOT A SOURCE CLAIM

scenes.text: How much extra downforce? Here the sources disagree. Wikipedia says forty percent more downforce than the Aventador SV and one percent lower drag coefficient. IEEE Spectrum says a thirty percent gain in downforce over the SV, much of it from ALA two point oh. By our arithmetic, the two claims differ by ten percentage points. Neither source explains why.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: +40% DOWNFORCE vs SV, DRAG COEFFICIENT 1% LOWER · IEEE SPECTRUM: +30% vs SV · DIFFERENCE 10 PERCENTAGE POINTS (OUR ARITHMETIC) · REASON: NOT GIVEN

scenes.text: The rest of the chassis supports the aero. IEEE Spectrum lists rear-wheel steering, an all-wheel-drive system that can switch to rear-wheel-only mode, and magnetorheological dampers at all four corners. Auto Bild says that in Sport mode, eighty percent of the power goes to the rear axle. These details describe a car designed to be driven at its limit.
scenes.caption: IEEE SPECTRUM: REAR-WHEEL STEERING · AWD THAT CAN GO RWD-ONLY · MAGNETORHEOLOGICAL DAMPERS · AUTO BILD: SPORT MODE 80% OF POWER TO REAR AXLE · 'DESIGNED TO BE DRIVEN AT ITS LIMIT' = OUR READING

scenes.text: Pirelli developed an exclusive tyre compound, IEEE says, in twenty-inch front and twenty-one-inch rear sizes. Auto Bild says the record lap used the optional Pirelli P Zero Trofeo R tyres. So the standard car's tyres and the record car's tyres may not be the same, though neither source says what the standard fitment was in the record run.
scenes.caption: IEEE SPECTRUM: EXCLUSIVE PIRELLI COMPOUND, 20 IN FRONT / 21 IN REAR · AUTO BILD: RECORD SETUP USED OPTIONAL PIRELLI P ZERO TROFEO R TYRES · WHETHER STANDARD TYRES DIFFER FROM THE RECORD TYRES: NOT STATED

scenes.text: The Nürburgring lap. Wikipedia: six minutes forty-four point nine seven, in July twenty eighteen, driven by Marco Mapelli, beating the Porsche nine eleven GT2 RS. Auto Bild gives the same time and says Lamborghini calls it the record for road-legal production cars, beating the GT2 RS's six forty-seven point three by about two seconds. Autocar repeats the time.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: 6:44.97, JULY 2018, MARCO MAPELLI, BEAT THE 911 GT2 RS · AUTO BILD: 'RECORD FOR ROAD-LEGAL PRODUCTION CARS, ACCORDING TO LAMBORGHINI'; GT2 RS 6:47.3 · AUTOCAR: SAME TIME

scenes.text: By our arithmetic, six forty-seven point three minus six forty-four point nine seven is two point three three seconds. That is about zero point six percent of the lap. Autocar compares it with the Huracán Performante's six fifty-two point oh one, which the SVJ beat by seven point oh four seconds, or one point eight percent.
scenes.caption: 6:47.3 − 6:44.97 = 2.33 S (0.58%) · 6:52.01 − 6:44.97 = 7.04 S (1.77%) (OUR ARITHMETIC; AUTO BILD, AUTOCAR, WIKIPEDIA)

scenes.text: IEEE Spectrum goes further. It says the SVJ's lap was about a minute faster than its predecessor and calls it the fastest production car ever tested on that circuit. Those are the outlet's wording. Wikipedia's note about the Huracán says only that the Performante prototype did six fifty-two point oh one and the GT2 RS later did six forty-seven point three.
scenes.caption: IEEE SPECTRUM: 'ABOUT A MINUTE FASTER THAN ITS PREDECESSOR'; 'FASTEST PRODUCTION CAR EVER TESTED' ON THAT CIRCUIT (OUTLET'S WORDING) · WIKIPEDIA (HURACÁN): PERFORMANTE PROTOTYPE 6:52.01; 911 GT2 RS 6:47.3

scenes.text: A caution about records. Lamborghini calls this a record for road-legal production cars, in Auto Bild's account, and the record is tied to specific tyres and conditions. Our sources do not list whether the lap was later beaten. We have no information about later laps by other cars, and we do not claim the time still stands today.
scenes.caption: AUTO BILD: RECORD CLAIM IS LAMBORGHINI'S; TIED TO OPTIONAL TROFEO R TYRES · LATER LAPS BY OTHER CARS: NOT IN OUR SOURCES → WE DO NOT CLAIM THE RECORD STANDS TODAY

scenes.text: The IEEE Spectrum author drove the car at Circuito do Estoril and reached two hundred eighty kilometres per hour, which is one hundred seventy-four miles per hour. The author did not reach the claimed three hundred fifty top speed, which is two hundred seventeen miles per hour, and the article does not say why. It is a reminder that claims and drives are different things.
scenes.caption: IEEE SPECTRUM: AUTHOR REACHED 280 KM/H (174 MPH) AT CIRCUITO DO ESTORIL · CLAIMED TOP SPEED 350 KM/H (217 MPH) · 280 ÷ 350 = 80% (OUR ARITHMETIC) · REASON NOT GIVEN

scenes.text: Thing two. The SVJ's own figures differ between sources. Start with the weight. Wikipedia says one thousand five hundred twenty-five kilograms dry and seventeen seventy with fluids in the United States. Autocar says a claimed kerb weight of fifteen twenty-five without fluids and seventeen seventy as tested. Auto Bild says fifteen twenty-five, fifteen thirty-five and over sixteen hundred.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: 1,525 KG DRY; 1,770 KG WITH FLUIDS (U.S.) · AUTOCAR: 1,525 KG CLAIMED, WITHOUT FLUIDS; 1,770 KG AS TESTED · AUTO BILD: 1,525 KG ('GESCHÖNT' DRY), 1,535 KG EMPTY, 'OVER 1,600 KG' · WIKIPEDIA TABLE: 1,525–1,575 KG RANGE
scenes.chapter: Thing two: the numbers nobody agrees on

scenes.text: By our arithmetic, the gap between dry and tested weights is two hundred forty-five kilograms, sixteen percent more. That is a large difference for the same car. Auto Bild's own description of the dry figure as flattering is one outlet's view. Power to weight depends on which you use, as the next scene shows.
scenes.caption: 1,770 − 1,525 = 245 KG (+16.1%) (OUR ARITHMETIC) · AUTO BILD 'GESCHÖNT' = 'FLATTERING' (OUTLET'S VIEW)

scenes.text: Power to weight, by our arithmetic. With seven hundred fifty-nine horsepower and fifteen twenty-five kilograms, it is zero point four nine eight horsepower per kilogram, which matches Autocar's claim of four ninety-eight per tonne. With the tested seventeen seventy, it is zero point four two nine. The difference is fourteen percent, from the weight alone.
scenes.caption: 759 ÷ 1,525 = 0.498 HP/KG (AUTOCAR CLAIM: 498 BHP/TONNE) · 759 ÷ 1,770 = 0.429 HP/KG · 0.429 ÷ 0.498 = −13.8% (OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: Next, power itself. Wikipedia and Auto Bild give seven hundred seventy metric horsepower, which Wikipedia converts to seven hundred fifty-nine horsepower and five hundred sixty-six kilowatts. Autocar uses seven fifty-nine brake horsepower at eighty-five hundred revs. Torque is seven hundred twenty newton-metres, or five hundred thirty-one pound-feet. These agree, as the metric and imperial units differ only by conversion.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA + AUTO BILD: 770 PS (566 KW; 759 HP) @ 8,500 RPM; 720 N·M @ 6,750 · AUTOCAR: 759 BHP; 531 LB-FT · 720 N·M = 531 LB-FT (OUR CONVERSION)

scenes.text: The 0–100 time differs slightly. Wikipedia and Auto Bild give two point eight seconds to one hundred kilometres per hour. IEEE Spectrum says two point nine. Autocar's measured zero to sixty miles per hour is two point nine. Wikipedia adds zero to two hundred in eight point six. By our arithmetic, two point eight and two point nine are a difference of three and a half percent.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA + AUTO BILD: 0–100 KM/H 2.8 S · IEEE: 2.9 S · AUTOCAR (TESTED): 0–60 MPH 2.9 S; 0–100 MPH 6.1 S; 0–150 MPH 13.2 S · WIKIPEDIA: 0–200 KM/H 8.6 S · 2.9 ÷ 2.8 = +3.6% (OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: Top speed: Wikipedia lists three hundred fifty kilometres per hour as official, two hundred seventeen miles per hour, and says Sport Auto measured three hundred fifty-four on the Aventador in general. Auto Bild says over three hundred fifty. Autocar does not give a top speed. The measured figure in Wikipedia refers to the Aventador family, and we cannot tell whether it was an SVJ.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: SVJ 350 KM/H (217 MPH); AVENTADOR TOP SPEED SECTION — SPORT AUTO MEASURED 354 KM/H (CAR NOT SPECIFIED IN THE PASSAGE) · AUTO BILD: 'OVER 350' · AUTOCAR: NOT GIVEN

scenes.text: Braking is another place with competing numbers. Wikipedia and Auto Bild do not give a stopping distance for the SVJ in the passages we used, though Auto Bild says about thirty metres from one hundred kilometres per hour. Autocar measured seventy to zero miles per hour in forty point eight metres, compared with the McLaren Senna's thirty-seven point four and the Ferrari eight twelve Superfast's forty-two point one.
scenes.caption: AUTO BILD: ~30 M FROM 100 KM/H (CLAIM) · AUTOCAR: 70–0 MPH 40.8 M (400 MM FRONT / 380 MM REAR CARBON-CERAMIC) · SENNA 37.4 M · 812 SUPERFAST 42.1 M · 100–0 KM/H AND 70–0 MPH ARE DIFFERENT MEASURES — NOT COMPARABLE

scenes.text: Prices vary by market. IEEE Spectrum gives a base price of five hundred seventeen thousand seven hundred seventy dollars. Auto Bild gives three hundred forty-nine thousand one hundred sixteen euros for the coupe and four hundred sixty thousand five hundred thirty-eight euros for the roadster. Autocar says the car starts at three hundred sixty thousand pounds and can easily top four hundred thousand.
scenes.caption: IEEE SPECTRUM: $517,770 BASE · AUTO BILD (2018): €349,116 COUPÉ; €460,538 ROADSTER · AUTOCAR (2025): FROM £360,000; TEST CAR WELL OVER £400,000 AFTER OPTIONS · AUTOMONITOR (UNSOURCED): ROADSTER $573,966

scenes.text: We cannot convert those figures honestly because our sources give no exchange rates and different taxes apply in each market. What we can say, by our arithmetic, is that Auto Bild's roadster costs thirty-two percent more than its coupé, and that Autocar's test car cost at least eleven percent more than the starting price, once options were added.
scenes.caption: €460,538 ÷ €349,116 = +31.9% · £400,000 ÷ £360,000 = +11.1% (OUR ARITHMETIC) · EXCHANGE RATES AND TAX TREATMENT: NOT IN OUR SOURCES

scenes.text: Production is the third thing that does not agree. Wikipedia lists nine hundred coupés and eight hundred roadsters, plus sixty-three SVJ 63 coupés and sixty-three SVJ 63 roadsters. The nine hundred figure is flagged as needing a citation. Auto Bild says nine hundred units plus a sixty-three-car SVJ 63. Autocar says nine hundred planned.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: 900 COUPÉS ([CITATION NEEDED]), 800 ROADSTERS, 63 SVJ 63 COUPÉS, 63 SVJ 63 ROADSTERS · AUTO BILD: 900 + SVJ 63 (63 UNITS); ROADSTER ~800 · AUTOCAR: 900 PLANNED

scenes.text: By our arithmetic, nine hundred plus eight hundred plus sixty-three plus sixty-three is eighteen hundred twenty-six cars. The weaker Automonitor page gives that same sum, but also quotes a related blurb saying only seventeen hundred sixty-three were built. The difference is sixty-three cars, exactly the size of one SVJ 63 run. We cannot tell which is right.
scenes.caption: 900 + 800 + 63 + 63 = 1,826 (OUR ARITHMETIC) · AUTOMONITOR (UNSOURCED): ALSO CITES 1,763 · 1,826 − 1,763 = 63 (OUR ARITHMETIC) · WHICH IS RIGHT: NOT SETTLED IN OUR SOURCES

scenes.text: In the context of the whole model, Wikipedia says total Aventador production was eleven thousand eight hundred thirty-one cars, with a peak of twelve hundred eighty-six in twenty seventeen. By our arithmetic, the SVJ family would be about fifteen percent of the total, if the eighteen twenty-six figure is right. The Aventador was originally planned for four thousand units.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: TOTAL AVENTADOR 11,831 (COUPÉ 6,196; ROADSTER 3,196 THROUGH 2019); PEAK 1,286 (2017); ORIGINALLY PLANNED 4,000 · 1,826 ÷ 11,831 = 15.4% (OUR ARITHMETIC; ASSUMES 1,826 IS CORRECT)

scenes.text: The SVJ is not the only extreme Aventador. Wikipedia lists the SV, with seven hundred fifty metric horsepower and one horsepower for every two kilograms, built as six hundred coupés and five hundred roadsters until July twenty seventeen. The SVJ followed in twenty eighteen, and the final Ultimae in twenty twenty-one, with seven hundred eighty metric horsepower, limited to six hundred cars.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: SV 750 PS, 600 COUPÉS + 500 ROADSTERS, ENDED JULY 2017 · SVJ 2018, 770 PS · ULTIMAE (LP 780-4, 2021) 780 PS, LIMITED TO 600 (350 COUPÉS, 250 ROADSTERS)
scenes.chapter: Where it sits in the story

scenes.text: By our arithmetic, the power rose from seven hundred metric horsepower in the original to seven eighty in the Ultimae, an increase of eleven percent over the car's life. The SVJ's seven seventy was ten percent above the original. In that sense, the SVJ delivered nearly all of the Aventador's power growth, and the Ultimae added only ten more horsepower.
scenes.caption: 700 → 780 PS = +11.4% · 700 → 770 PS = +10.0% · 770 → 780 = +10 PS (+1.3%) (OUR ARITHMETIC; WIKIPEDIA FIGURES)

scenes.text: The engine behind it is the same family. Wikipedia describes a six point five litre sixty-degree V12 weighing about two hundred thirty-five kilograms, with a seven-speed single-clutch automated manual gearbox. Autocar's review criticised that gearbox, and the interior ergonomics and ride comfort, while praising the engine's character and the car's dynamic precision.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: L539 6.5 L (6,498 CC) 60° V12, ~235 KG; 7-SPEED GRAZIANO ISR SINGLE-CLUTCH AUTOMATED MANUAL · AUTOCAR: PRAISED ENGINE + DYNAMIC PRECISION; CRITICISED GEARBOX, INTERIOR ERGONOMICS, RIDE · NOT AWARDED FIVE STARS

scenes.text: Efficiency numbers from Autocar: eleven point nine miles per gallon and four hundred fifty-two grams of carbon dioxide per kilometre. Wikipedia gives the original Aventador at seventeen point two litres per 100 kilometres and 398 grams. By our arithmetic, seventeen point two litres per 100 kilometres is about thirteen point seven miles per gallon, so the two figures are for different cars and tests.
scenes.caption: AUTOCAR (SVJ): 11.9 MPG; 452 G/KM · WIKIPEDIA (LP 700-4): 17.2 L/100 KM; 398 G/KM · 17.2 L/100 KM = 13.7 US MPG (OUR CONVERSION) · DIFFERENT CARS AND TEST METHODS

scenes.text: Cabin noise was measured by Autocar at ninety-six decibels at 8,500 revs in third gear, second only to the McLaren Senna. The roofline is sixty millimetres lower than a McLaren 720S, it says. Heated seats cost three thousand pounds and the Sensonum sound system three thousand one hundred fifty-six. By our arithmetic, those two options alone are sixty-one hundred fifty-six pounds.
scenes.caption: AUTOCAR: 96 DB AT 8,500 RPM IN 3RD, SECOND ONLY TO THE SENNA · ROOFLINE 60 MM LOWER THAN A 720S · HEATED SEATS £3,000 · SENSONUM £3,156 · £3,000 + £3,156 = £6,156 (OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: What came next? Wikipedia describes the Ultimae, the final Aventador variant, introduced in twenty twenty-one as the LP seven eighty-four, with seven hundred eighty metric horsepower and seven hundred twenty newton-metres. It weighs fifteen hundred fifty kilograms, does zero to one hundred in two point eight four seconds, and reaches three hundred fifty-four kilometres per hour, which is two hundred twenty miles per hour.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: ULTIMAE (LP 780-4, 2021) — 780 PS (574 KW; 769 HP) · 720 N·M · 1,550 KG · 0–100 KM/H 2.84 S · 354 KM/H (220 MPH)

scenes.text: It was limited to six hundred units, three hundred fifty coupés and two hundred fifty roadsters. But Wikipedia's delivery table shows seven hundred ninety-eight in twenty twenty-one and seven hundred fifty-three in twenty twenty-two across the whole Aventador line, without a split. By our arithmetic, those two years add up to fifteen hundred fifty-one, and the page does not explain how that squares with six hundred.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: ULTIMAE LIMITED TO 600 (350 COUPÉS + 250 ROADSTERS) · TABLE: 798 (2021) + 753 (2022) = 1,551 (OUR ARITHMETIC) FOR THE WHOLE AVENTADOR LINE, NO BODY-STYLE SPLIT · GAP NOT EXPLAINED ON THE PAGE

scenes.text: The end of the line has a twist. Wikipedia says that in February twenty twenty-two, a fire aboard the Felicity Ace destroyed fifteen cars, and Lamborghini restarted Ultimae production. The last car, built in July twenty twenty-two, was styled as a homage to a nineteen sixty-eight Miura P four hundred. The page's infobox, though, gives the end of production as September.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: FELICITY ACE FIRE, FEB 2022 — 15 CARS DESTROYED; ULTIMAE PRODUCTION RESTARTED · LAST CAR JULY 2022, HOMAGE TO A 1968 MIURA P400 · INFOBOX: PRODUCTION ENDED SEPT 2022 (CONFLICT WITH TEXT)

scenes.text: The last Ultimae coupé sold for over one point six million dollars at RM Sotheby's in April twenty twenty-two, with a one-of-one digital token, Wikipedia says. By our arithmetic, that is three times the SVJ's original five hundred seventeen thousand seven hundred seventy dollar base price, though the two cars are different and the auction included the token.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: LAST ULTIMAE COUPÉ > $1.6 M, RM SOTHEBY'S, APRIL 2022, WITH A 1-OF-1 NFT · $1.6 M ÷ $517,770 = 3.1× (OUR ARITHMETIC; DIFFERENT CARS; TOKEN INCLUDED)

scenes.text: Used SVJs are another data point. A Lamborghini enthusiast site, in May twenty twenty-two, listed used Aventador prices from three hundred fifteen thousand dollars for a twenty sixteen car up to nine hundred seventy-five thousand for a twenty twenty SVJ Roadster. By our arithmetic, the SVJ Roadster at that price was seventy percent above its original base of five hundred seventy-three thousand nine hundred sixty-six.
scenes.caption: LAMBOCARS (4 MAY 2022): USED AVENTADOR LISTINGS $315,000 (2016) TO $975,000 (2020 SVJ ROADSTER) · AUTOMONITOR (UNSOURCED) ROADSTER MSRP $573,966 · $975,000 ÷ $573,966 = +69.9% (OUR ARITHMETIC; LISTING, NOT A SALE)

scenes.text: Automonitor's page, which cites no sources, estimates the SVJ coupé market at five hundred fifty to seven hundred fifty thousand dollars, and the SVJ 63 at eight hundred fifty thousand to one point two million. We use these only as flagged estimates. Its own table shows a coupé average of five hundred thirty thousand in twenty twenty rising to six hundred sixty thousand in a twenty twenty-five estimate.
scenes.caption: AUTOMONITOR (UNSOURCED, INTERNALLY INCONSISTENT): COUPÉ $550–750K · SVJ 63 COUPÉ $850K–1.2M+ · AVERAGE VALUE 2020 $530K → 2025 EST. $660K → +24.5% (OUR ARITHMETIC) · BAT NAMED AS SOURCE, NO DATA SHOWN

scenes.text: The wider story is the end of an era. IEEE Spectrum, writing in twenty nineteen, says Lamborghini was developing a gas-electric V12 hybrid successor to the Aventador. Wikipedia names that successor as the Revuelto, which arrived in twenty twenty-three. So the SVJ sits among the last naturally aspirated V12 Lamborghinis, though our sources do not state that as a ranking.
scenes.caption: IEEE SPECTRUM (2019): HYBRID V12 SUCCESSOR IN DEVELOPMENT · WIKIPEDIA: SUCCESSOR = REVUELTO (2023) · 'AMONG THE LAST NATURALLY ASPIRATED V12s' = OUR INFERENCE FROM THESE TWO FACTS

scenes.text: A few last numbers on the SVJ roadster, from Wikipedia and Auto Bild. The roadster version of the base car weighs sixteen twenty-five kilograms, fifty more than the coupé, and its roof panels weigh six kilograms each. For the SVJ Roadster, Auto Bild says around eight hundred units, zero to one hundred in two point nine seconds, launching in late summer twenty nineteen.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA (BASE ROADSTER): 1,625 KG, 50 KG MORE THAN COUPÉ; ROOF PANELS 6 KG EACH · AUTO BILD (SVJ ROADSTER): ~800 UNITS; 0–100 KM/H 2.9 S; LAUNCH LATE SUMMER 2019

scenes.text: By our arithmetic, the roadster's two point nine seconds is only point one slower than the coupé's two point eight, or three and a half percent. That is tiny for a car that gives up a fixed roof, and shows how much of the performance comes from the engine and aerodynamics rather than the body. The sources do not give the SVJ Roadster's weight.
scenes.caption: AUTO BILD: COUPÉ 2.8 S; ROADSTER 2.9 S · +0.1 S = +3.6% (OUR ARITHMETIC) · SVJ ROADSTER WEIGHT: NOT IN OUR SOURCES · 'PERFORMANCE COMES FROM ENGINE AND AERO' = OUR READING

scenes.text: IEEE Spectrum says the engine uses titanium connecting rods and reduced internal friction. Wikipedia says it displaces sixty-four ninety-eight cubic centimetres and weighs about two hundred thirty-five kilograms. By our arithmetic, seven hundred fifty-nine horsepower from six point five litres is one hundred sixteen point eight horsepower per litre, and about three point two horsepower per kilogram of engine.
scenes.caption: IEEE: TITANIUM CONNECTING RODS, REDUCED INTERNAL FRICTION · WIKIPEDIA: 6,498 CC, ~235 KG · 759 ÷ 6.5 = 116.8 HP/L · 759 ÷ 235 = 3.23 HP/KG OF ENGINE (OUR ARITHMETIC)
scenes.chapter: The engine and the acceleration, in numbers

scenes.text: The SVJ makes its peak power at eighty-five hundred revs and its peak torque at sixty-seven fifty. By our arithmetic, that means the engine must rev well past six and a half thousand to deliver its best, which Autocar's note on cabin noise at eighty-five hundred in third gear, ninety-six decibels, supports. Naturally aspirated engines make power by revving, and this one does.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA + AUTOCAR: PEAK POWER 8,500 RPM; PEAK TORQUE 6,750 RPM · AUTOCAR: 96 DB AT 8,500 RPM IN 3RD · 'MUST REV PAST 6,500' = OUR READING OF THE TORQUE PEAK

scenes.text: Autocar's own acceleration times give a feel for the car's reach. Zero to sixty in two point nine seconds, zero to a hundred miles per hour in six point one, zero to one fifty in thirteen point two. By our arithmetic, the step from sixty to one hundred takes three point two seconds, and from one hundred to one fifty takes seven point one.
scenes.caption: AUTOCAR: 0–60 MPH 2.9 S · 0–100 MPH 6.1 S · 0–150 MPH 13.2 S · 6.1 − 2.9 = 3.2 S (60→100) · 13.2 − 6.1 = 7.1 S (100→150) (OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: Wikipedia's metric figures are two point eight to one hundred and eight point six to two hundred kilometres per hour. By our arithmetic, the step from one hundred to two hundred takes five point eight seconds. That is a longer time than the first hundred, which is typical for any car, but it is still very short for a hundred kilometres per hour of extra speed.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: 0–100 2.8 S; 0–200 KM/H 8.6 S · 8.6 − 2.8 = 5.8 S (OUR ARITHMETIC) · 'TYPICAL FOR ANY CAR' = OUR GENERAL OBSERVATION

scenes.text: IEEE Spectrum says the author's drive reached two hundred eighty kilometres per hour. Using Autocar's tested zero to one hundred fifty miles per hour of thirteen point two seconds, that is two hundred forty-one kilometres per hour, so the Estoril run went beyond it. We do not know how long it took the IEEE author to reach two eighty, as the article does not say.
scenes.caption: AUTOCAR: 150 MPH = 241 KM/H IN 13.2 S (OUR CONVERSION) · IEEE: 280 KM/H AT ESTORIL; TIME TO REACH IT: NOT GIVEN

scenes.text: Tyres, again. Those exclusive Pirelli tyres are twenty inches at the front and twenty-one at the rear. Lambocars says Lamborghini tyres in general cost fifteen hundred to two thousand dollars a set, though not specifically for the SVJ. The weaker Automonitor page claims three thousand five hundred to five thousand. Those two ranges overlap not at all, and neither is a measured SVJ price.
scenes.caption: IEEE: 20 IN FRONT / 21 IN REAR · LAMBOCARS (2022): LAMBORGHINI TYRES $1,500–2,000/SET (NOT SVJ-SPECIFIC) · AUTOMONITOR (UNSOURCED): $3,500–5,000/SET · RANGES DO NOT OVERLAP (OUR OBSERVATION) · SVJ-SPECIFIC PRICE: NOT IN OUR SOURCES

scenes.text: What is missing. Which downforce figure is right, thirty or forty percent. The SVJ's true production count. A dated source saying whether the Nürburgring time was later beaten. The standard tyre fitment on the record run. A reconciled weight, on a like-for-like basis. And an official price list across markets. If you have a primary document for any of these, put it in the comments.

scenes.chapter: What the sources do not say

scenes.text: So the two things are these. The SVJ's wing deliberately gives up grip to cut drag, then takes it back through corners, and its record lap used optional tyres. And its figures, from weight to production, differ depending on who you ask. In the other videos this week, we compare the SVJ with the Huracán STO, count what it costs, and tell why it was the last of its kind. Subscribe to Pickup Reality.
